background: Belfius is a Belgian retail, public-sector and insurance group wholly owned by the Belgian state, funded by Belgian retail deposits and lending to households, companies and Belgian local authorities.
synthesis: Ratings are A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 21 Apr 2026 the latest move. Against EU and Nordic peers capital is strong: CET1 of 16.2% is at the peer median and leverage of 6.2% is above it. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 145% below the peer median and NSFR of 129% above it; leverage has fallen 0.4 points since 30 Jun 2024 and the rest has been flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
